title_zh: 请接待员转达感觉变化

scenario.label_zh: 向虚构手术团队转达症状描述
scenario.goal_zh: 说明感觉变化并约定转达给手术团队而不作诊断

context_zh: 完全虚构的英语电话练习：成年患者角色 Elena 致电手术团队接待员角色 Marcus，只练习描述和转达，不提供诊疗建议。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: My letter gives this number for the surgical team. Could you pass on a message?

sentences.speaker: Marcus
sentences.text: Yes. Tell me what you would like me to record.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: There’s a tingling sensation around my hand, and I’ve noticed more sensitivity when my sleeve touches it.

sentences.speaker: Marcus
sentences.text: I’ll record those words. I’m the receptionist, so I can’t tell you what is causing it.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: Thank you. Please ask a member of the team to contact me.

sentences.speaker: Marcus
sentences.text: I’ll forward the description and your request. I can’t confirm a callback time.
